killedBy: the controller self-test poll is scoped to the pane (issue #599) a frame already dispatched when the pane closes does not queue another
why: Cancelling the pending handle cannot reach a callback that has already run and re-requested, so the flag is the half that ends the chain. Without it the poll reads the hardware on every frame for the life of the page over a pane that is gone -- and the driver does not tick while a pane is up, so nothing else would ever notice. MEASURED AS A SURVIVOR first: with only the open/close/stop cases, removing the flag left every one of them green, because a cancelled frame simply never runs. The case that kills it takes a dispatched frame OUT of the queue before closing, which is the state `cancelAnimationFrame` cannot reach.
